title: 日本ダービーの後に・逃したのは誰

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You came all this way to meet me? Don't you have anything better to do?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You don't need to worry. I may have lost the Derby title, but…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm not done with the Classics yet. There's still the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.
choice_data_list: Are you going to get that?
Are you going to get that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …It's fine. I'm ignoring it on pur—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh no… I dropped it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep.

text_block_list.name: Phone
text_block_list.text: Hello? King, are you there?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why? Why does she have to call me now?!

text_block_list.name: Phone
text_block_list.text: If you're there, then answer me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Hello, Mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: So I finally get a reply. I swear, the little games you like to play—you're like a child.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, you just like to treat me like one…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I can't always answer you immediately. I have business to attend to, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. I imagine you're referring to the Derby. Which reminds me, it was quite something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: It's been a good while since I've seen someone capture the hearts of the crowd with their running like Special Week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: How unfortunate it is to run against someone like her. I bet you're ready to throw in the towel about now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: You're better off coming home now, before you have another chance to disgrace yourself even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep. Click.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What a way to speak to someone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All she does is call me out of the blue, saying I'll disgrace myself and telling me to give up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Do I give up easily? Will I disgrace myself?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Quite the opposite! I am a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Listen, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Kikuka Sho! First place will be mine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I won't lose to anyone, be it Seiun Sky or Special Week!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I'm King Halo! A first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And I deserve to be recognized!
